capabilities: render charts, data tables and metric grids from inline or vault dataset files
draw timelines for milestones, dates, owners and progress
record decisions with status, owner, reasons and next steps
draw flow diagrams with steps, decision branches and outcomes
import writing instructions as agent skills or Markdown guides
extras: Blocks render only in Reading view, not Live Preview, and the plugin requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It runs locally with no network requests and registers .mdx files to open as Markdown vault-wide unless another plugin handles that extension.
motivation: The author built it for notes written with an AI Agent, keeping the data and instructions as readable text while showing the visual result, so the agent can edit values directly without a separate image to keep in sync.
problem: Obsidian shows notes as plain text, so explaining data visually requires images that agents cannot read or edit and that drift out of sync with the source text.

relations.evidence: Charts use the bundled Ant Design Charts library, distributed under the MIT license.

requires.name: your own AI agent with vault access

summary: Renders declarative content blocks in notes — charts, data tables, metric cards, timelines, decision records and flow diagrams — from inline CSV, JSON or dataset files.
